description: Codex usage-limit reset announcements recorded by tokenusage.dev's Reset Alerts from @thsottiaux's public posts on X, newest first (at most 50): each post's link, when it was posted, when this site recorded it and resetType, plus when the monitor last checked X successfully. resetType is automatic, banked or both; null means recorded before Reset Alerts recorded reset types. A banked reset grant saves a reset for eligible users to apply later and does not itself refill limits. An announcement may describe a forthcoming event or one already completed; a post is not proof that any account's limit was reset. Open its url for the exact wording and eligibility. Only @thsottiaux is watched. Unofficial, not affiliated with OpenAI. Source: https://tokenusage.dev/resets

limit.description: How many announcements to return, newest first: 1 to 50, default 10.

name: get_codex_reset_announcements

generatedAt.description: When tokenusage.dev read this data, ISO 8601 UTC. The server caches it for up to 15 seconds.

lastPolledAt.description: The monitor's latest successful fetch of @thsottiaux's X timeline, checks that found no new posts included, ISO 8601 UTC; null before the first, or when an older record lacks it. It is not a sign that classification or alert delivery is working.

detectedAt.description: When this site recorded the post, ISO 8601 UTC; posts recorded when the monitor started share one time.

postedAt.description: When the post was published, ISO 8601 UTC.

resetType.description: The monitor's classification of the post: automatic is a direct usage-limit reset with no saved reset; banked is a reset grant saved for eligible users to apply later; both announces both types. Both classifier calls must give the same type. Null means recorded before Reset Alerts recorded reset types. This is not proof that any account's limit was reset.

source.description: The fixed credit URL, https://tokenusage.dev/resets. When showing the data to other people, show Data: tokenusage.dev linked to this URL on the same screen or in the same message. Personal use needs no visible credit. API and MCP relays must retain source and pass on this credit condition.

title: Codex reset announcements
